description: Validates a job without running it or charging. Call this before submit to see the price and time. Prefer this over submit with operation check when you only need pricing; use submit check when you need the validation report. Returns the price (price_usd, usual_price_usd, meter, breakdown, knobs), a one-line summary, whether the cache will hit, a quote, and a labeled time estimate. accept_required is true when the price is above the usual one. quote_required is true for batches and sweeps, and the quote id is in the result. A bake also includes the draft and final price of the same spec. A sweep includes its price range, axes, and parts. Large runs paginate per_variant with price_cursor. too_large names a knob that would bring the run under the time limit. quote_warning may include a suggested domain.voxel_m and price.

batch.description: Run variations in list, axis and seed order.

idempotency_key.description: For a batch or sweep retry, supply its original key to estimate the stored quote and incremental daily allowance.

inputs.description: Registered input files, named in the spec by `as`.

max_cost_usd.description: Refuse (COST_LIMIT) if this job would cost more. Batches and sweeps also require the accepted quote ID.

module.description: Module id. pyro and pyrofx are the same fire, smoke, dust and explosion module. meshfx takes one GLB. geofx takes a .geo.toml terrain spec and up to four inputs. Optional when spec_name ends in a module extension.

operation.description: check is free and answered inline; bake and sweep are async jobs.

price_cursor.description: For a large run, pass sweep.price_cursor or the preceding sweep.next_cursor to read up to 100 row prices.

quality.description: draft or final. Bakes default to final. Batches and sweeps default to draft.

spec.description: The spec as TOML text, or the same tree as a JSON object. Fields come from the module schema.

sweep.description: For operation sweep: one {key, values}, or a list of axes with different keys.

terrain_shadows.description: geofx horizon sectors. Zero disables terrain shadows.

name: estimate
title: Estimate price and time
